methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in North America at 49.74% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 44.18%, followed by Samsung Internet at 3.29%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in North America?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 49.74% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/north-america.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in North America?
faqs.answer: Chrome (49.74%), Safari (44.18%), Samsung Internet (3.29%) in October 2026.
